profile.headline: Frontend Web Developer at agencyQ
profile.summary:
I'm a forever-student of web development and design that enjoys building user experiences with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
I've been building things for the web for over four years, and I'm currently digging further into React JS and Node. In the past, I've worked on projects using WordPress, Django, and Flask, and I love thinking about user experience and UI design/development.

company.name: Center for New Designs in Learning and Scholarship at Georgetown University

positions.title: Web Developer, Instructional Technologist
positions.description: Yong is interested in how information moves, whether through the processes of teaching and learning or through the channels that we use in networked communication. As a graduate of Georgetown's CCT program, he has studied how visual and interaction design can represent clear thinking, and how they create meaning for users of technology. An avid reader, writer, coder, and aspiring illustrator, Yong uses his passion for words, images, and movement to communicate the flow of ideas.

company.name: Center for New Designs in Learning and Scholarship

positions.title: Director, Social Media Club Education Connection
positions.description:
I coordinated Social Media Club Education Connection (often referred to as SMCEDU), a national project cultivating a community of educators, students, and professionals to advance social media in higher education. 

The goals of the project (currently headed by Terry Eberhart) focused on providing the resources and contacts for educators and administrators to develop their pedagogy around the use of collaborative technologies, while providing students direct contact to the professionals in their chosen industries.

positions.title: Freelance Writer
positions.description:
My writing centers on stories of technology, politics, and personal interest.

I am a contributor to the following sites:
SocialMediaClub.org
SMCedu.org
TheCelebrityCafe.com
ToTheCenter.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implementation of RIAs (graphically rich Web applications)

Study of HCI (Human Computer Interaction), user-friendly desgin

Technical writer, includes proof of concept white papers for research funding

positions.title: Project Support Specialist
positions.description:
Manipulated enterprise software to meet the needs of clients and project managers, recommended fundamental solutions to both clients and users
Tested new Web-based applications in both development and production environments
Productively juggled multiple projects and managed resources in a deadline-driven production environment
Utilized the Product Development Life Cycle

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description:
Mentored high school students in algebra, reading comprehension, and writing composition
Expanded ability to work with other individuals, understands differences in learning and teaching methods

positions.title: Information Specialist
positions.description:
Organized student records, worked extensively in an Oracle DBMS environment
Executed data input projects successfully with limited supervision
Ensured data integrity and provided quality assurance services
